title: Highest Rated K-Dramas of 2026: Viewership & Streaming Numbers
description: The numbers behind the hits. Which K-dramas dominated ratings, broke streaming records, and won the awards in 2026?
content:
Behind every viral K-drama moment are the numbers that tell the story. Here's a data-driven look at which dramas actually performed in 2026 — on terrestrial TV, cable, and streaming combined.

Terrestrial TV Champions (KBS/MBC/SBS)

1. "The Last Hanbok" (KBS2) — Peak 23.4%

The highest rated drama on any network since "Crash Landing on You" in 2020. A historical drama about hanbok craftsmanship spanning multiple generations. The finale had the entire country watching.

2. "Detective Gangnam" (SBS) — Peak 18.7%

A buddy cop thriller that found the perfect balance between comedy and genuine tension. Consistently delivered every week.

Cable/OTT Champions

1. "Squid Game 4" (Netflix) — 200M+ views globally in first week

The global juggernaut continued. Season 4 added new game designers as characters, brilliantly shifting the show's perspective.

2. "Hangang Blues" (Netflix) — 89M views globally

The slow-burn multi-generational drama found its audience through word-of-mouth. Critical favorite.

3. "Start-Up Season 2" (tvN) — 11.2% peak

The beloved startup romance returned with a time-skip. Divisive among the fanbase but ratings-dominant.

💡 Viewing Tip: In Korea, you can watch most terrestrial dramas free on the KBS, MBC, and SBS official YouTube channels with English subtitles added within 24 hours.
